newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets fell in September.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets fell in September.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Monday that U.S. reserve assets fell $1.27 billion in September to $75.51 billion from $76.78 billion in August.
Total U.S. holdings of foreign currencies were $38.86 billion last month, down from $39.83 billion in August.
Gold stock totaled $11.05 billion in both months.
Special Drawing Rights with the International Monetary Fund fell to $10.18 billion from $10.31 billion in August.
The value of the U.S. reserve position with the IMF fell to $15.42 billion in September from $15.60 billion in August.
